catalog.summary: Assign or unassign an exception user

patchExceptionUser.description:
Minimum role: Tenant Security Admin.

Updates the exception-user status for a user in a specific workspace. Use `op: assign` to grant exception-user access or `op: unassign` to revoke it. A caller cannot modify their own exception-user status.

parameters.name: userGuid
parameters.description: GUID of the user whose exception-user status is being changed; the same value as the Anaplan user ID. From `GET /users` (or `GET /users/me` for your own GUID) in the [Integration API](https://help.anaplan.com/integration-api-v20-3107aa54-d12b-4c48-9550-3561c84adbb2).

op.description: Operation to perform: `assign` grants exception-user access; `unassign` revokes it.

workspaceGuid.description: Anaplan-assigned hex-32 GUID of the workspace in which to assign or unassign the exception-user status. The workspace must be SSO-enabled. From `GET /workspaces` in the [Integration API](https://help.anaplan.com/integration-api-v20-3107aa54-d12b-4c48-9550-3561c84adbb2) (`workspaces[].id`).

patchExceptionUser.response_note: no documented 2xx JSON response schema — probe a read operation to learn it

searchExceptionUsers.description:
Minimum role: Standard User.

Search by workspace to list all exception users in that workspace (including visitors), or search by user to list all workspaces where that user has exception-user access (visitors' workspaces are excluded from the by-user results). Exactly one of `workspaceGuid` or `userGuid` must be provided.

workspaceGuid.description: Anaplan-assigned hex-32 GUID of the workspace. Returns all exception users in this workspace, including visitors. From `GET /workspaces` in the [Integration API](https://help.anaplan.com/integration-api-v20-3107aa54-d12b-4c48-9550-3561c84adbb2) (`workspaces[].id`).

userGuid.description: Anaplan-assigned hex-32 GUID of the user. Returns all workspaces in the tenant where this user has exception-user access. Workspaces where the user has access as a visitor are not included. From `GET /users` (or `GET /users/me` for your own GUID) in the [Integration API](https://help.anaplan.com/integration-api-v20-3107aa54-d12b-4c48-9550-3561c84adbb2) (`users[].id`).

schema.description: Search criteria. Provide exactly one of `workspaceGuid` (to list exception users in a workspace) or `userGuid` (to list workspaces where a user has exception-user access).

response.description: List of workspace records matching the search criteria.
